verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents automatic suppression of unsubscribes, hard bounces, or spam complaints, nor that such suppression is honored across all send types. The only related items are adjacent: default exclusion of unengaged contacts (graymail suppression), manual exclusion lists, and an unspecified 'won't be sent the email for a specific reason' view. None of these is the named capability, so the verdict stays at none.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
